div.div: Item 1 Comment:

This Amendment No. 2 ("Amendment No. 2") amends the statement on Schedule 13D filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 7, 2024, as amended on November 25, 2024 ("Amendment No. 1"), to reflect dispositions and acquisitions by the Reporting Persons. This Amendment No. 2 relates to common units representing limited partnership interests ("Common Units"), of Dorchester Minerals, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the "Partnership") and is filed in connection with pro-rata distributions made by the Reporting Persons to their respective limited partners. All references to Reporting Persons in the original Schedule 13D and Amendment No. 1 shall be deemed to include references to all Reporting Persons under this Amendment No. 2. The principal executive offices of the Partnership are located at 3838 Oak Lawn Avenue, Suite 300, Dallas, Texas 75219. Except as otherwise stated herein, there are no changes to the Schedule 13D.
